text: Would you like to join us on Saturday?
Sorry, I can't. Maybe next time.
Would you like to join us?
Claire, look. Ingrid sent a message. They invite us to a picnic on Saturday.
Oh, nice! Would you like to go?
Sure, I'd love to. And there is a jazz concert at night.
Jazz? Hmm. I don't know. I don't think I like jazz.
Come on! The tickets are free. Would you like to try?
OK, I'll try. What can we take to the picnic?
Some cheese and bread. I'll buy them in the morning. Would you like to come with me?
Sorry, I can't. I have a call with my sister at ten. Maybe next time.
No problem. And Mads can pick us up at the hotel.
Yes, please. The park is far from here.
Perfect. Would you like a coffee before we go?
Yes, please. And write to Ingrid: we'd love to join them!

Hi, Leao, it's Mads, from the boat tour. Listen, Ingrid and I want to invite you and Claire to our house for dinner on Friday, at seven. Would you like to come? I'm cooking fish, and Ingrid is making a big salad. After dinner there is a small concert near our house, ten minutes on foot. Would you like to go with us? It's free. And on Sunday, would you like to rent bikes and ride to the beach? Copenhagen is a city of bikes! Send me a message, OK? Talk soon. Bye!

Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Our flight to London is two hours and twenty minutes. In a few minutes we will come with dinner. Would you like chicken or pasta tonight? And to drink, we have water, juice, coffee and tea. After dinner, would you like a blanket? Just ask. It can be cold at night. Would you like a newspaper? We have English and Danish newspapers. We land in London at ten thirty. Thank you, and enjoy your flight.

Ingrid sent a message and invited us to a picnic. I asked Claire, would you like to go? Claire said, sure, I'd love to. I said, I'll buy some cheese. Would you like to come with me? Claire said, sorry, I can't. Maybe next time.
